forecast_models.label: NOAA GFS
forecast_models.summary: The longest reach, and fine detail across the US. Works anywhere. Blends in the HRRR model.

forecast_models.label: ECCC GEM
forecast_models.summary: The most detail over Canada and the northern US, and coarse elsewhere. Blends in the HRDPS and RDPS models.

forecast_models.label: ECMWF IFS
forecast_models.summary: The most reliable for choosing which weekend to go. Too coarse to tell one valley from the next.

forecast_models.label: NOAA HRRR
forecast_models.summary: The most detail over the US for the next 48 hours. Already inside NOAA GFS, which reaches further.

forecast_models.label: UK Met Office
forecast_models.summary: The most detail over the UK and Ireland, and coarse elsewhere. Blends in the UKV model.

forecast_models.label: DWD ICON
forecast_models.summary: The most detail over Germany and the Alps, and coarse elsewhere. Blends in the ICON-D2 and ICON-EU models.

forecast_models.label: JMA GSM
forecast_models.summary: The most detail over Japan and Korea, and coarse elsewhere. Blends in the MSM model.

forecast_models.label: Meteo-France ARPEGE
forecast_models.summary: The most detail over France, and coarse elsewhere. Blends in the AROME model.
